## History

Miss Rogerson is a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who taught her class for twenty years. During one service, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended her class alone while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stayed home sick, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) felt out of place during the lesson.
